The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: LoL: Kiwoom DRX vs Nongshim Red Force (BO3) - LCK Rounds 1-2
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Kiwoom DRX and Nongshim Red Force in the LCK Rounds 1-2, initially scheduled for May 2 at 6:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Kiwoom DRX" if Kiwoom DRX win the match against Nongshim Red Force.

This market will resolve to "Nongshim Red Force" if Nongshim Red Force win the match against Kiwoom DRX.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kiwoom DRX faces Nongshim RedForce in LCK Rounds 1-2 Week 5 BO3 rematch on May 2, seeking to snap a five-game losing streak after their 2-0 upset win over NS on April 11. DRX languishes 9th at 2-7 (5-15 maps), fresh off a 2-1 loss to Gen.G on April 30, while 6th-place NS (4-5, 9-11 maps) rides a three-loss skid versus T1, Gen.G, and Hanwha Life Esports. Nongshim's midlaner Scout anchors their lineup against Ucal, bolstered by new ADC Diable replacing Taeyoon last week; DRX fields Rich top, Willer jungle, LazyFeel bot, and Andil support. In the double round-robin race for top-six Road to MSI spots, DRX's home edge and recent head-to-head dominance counter NS's superior standing amid macro-focused patch dynamics.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's duo Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen top trader consensus at 34.6% implied probability for Eurovision 2026 victory in Vienna, driven by their UMK-winning entry "Liekinheitin"—a viral fusion of classical violin and pop that delivers strong jury appeal and televote chemistry, consistently leading bookie odds and OGAE polls since national finals wrapped in March. Greece's Akylas follows at 18.8% on "Ferto"'s explosive televote potential from Sing for Greece, while Denmark surges to 12.6% amid pre-party buzz and recent odds climbs. Australia (Delta Goodrem's "Eclipse"), France, and others trail in this wide-open field of 35 entries, with first rehearsals kicking off today poised to spark shifts via staging reveals and live previews ahead of semis on May 12-14 and final on May 16.

title: LoL: Weibo Gaming vs Top Esports (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Weibo Gaming and Top Esports in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Weibo Gaming" if Weibo Gaming win the match against Top Esports.

This market will resolve to "Top Esports" if Top Esports win the match against Weibo Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Weibo Gaming rides high into this LPL Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 after sweeping Top Esports 2-0 on April 28, snapping TES's 12-game win streak that featured clean victories over BLG, JDG, AL, and others. TES, sitting second in standings at 6-2 overall, holds a dominant 12-8 head-to-head edge but showed vulnerabilities in macro execution against WBG's improved teamfighting and objective control. WBG, mid-table at 5-5, gains crucial momentum for playoff seeding in the competitive Group Ascend stage, where both squads boast stable rosters amid the current patch meta favoring early aggression. Recent form suggests a tight series with revenge potential for TES.

title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

A regional ceasefire enabled mobilization of engineers and workers, with two of three production trains already restarted per industry sources, well ahead of the April 30 deadline. eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President J.D. Vance holds the second spot at 39% implied probability on Polymarket for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, trailing Robert F. Kennedy Jr. at 49%, as traders weigh post-Trump succession dynamics amid constitutional term limits barring the president's reelection. RFK Jr.'s lead stems from his prominent role as a Trump administration surrogate, including a recent midterm travel push to promote the MAHA movement, bolstering his appeal to MAGA voters despite his independent 2024 run. Vance's odds have slipped from prior highs amid perceived foreign policy setbacks like stalled Iran negotiations, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 21% gains traction from a strong CPAC straw poll finish and climbing betting markets. The 2026 midterms loom as a key test for early frontrunners' momentum ahead of primaries.

eventMetadata.context_description: Gavin Newsom leads trader consensus for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination at 26.3% implied probability in a wide-open primary field, reflecting his perceived electability edge in early general election polls against potential GOP foes like JD Vance, amid skepticism toward Kamala Harris following her 2024 defeat. Harris's April 10 signal of interest in another run drew immediate pushback, with top Democrats refusing endorsements by late April and liberal columnists arguing against her candidacy, capping her at 11%. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez trails at 8.5% on progressive base appeal, while Jon Ossoff's 6.6% stems from Georgia swing-state strength. Consolidation could hinge on 2026 midterm results, fundraising leads, and party endorsements, with Pete Buttigieg and Josh Shapiro teasing bids at recent events.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal face significant hurdles despite a Pakistan-mediated ceasefire holding since April 8, 2026, following the brief 2026 Iran war. President Trump expressed dissatisfaction on May 1 with Iran's latest proposal, which offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end fighting while delaying nuclear talks, amid US insistence on strict curbs to Iran's nuclear enrichment, ballistic missile program, and sanctions relief. Sticking points persist in indirect talks via Islamabad, with no breakthroughs in the past week. Traders monitor for diplomatic progress before potential deadlines, as historical JCPOA revival efforts underscore the challenges of achieving verifiable, long-term de-escalation.

title: LoL: Team WE vs JD Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Team WE and JD Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 3:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Team WE" if Team WE win the match against JD Gaming.

This market will resolve to "JD Gaming" if JD Gaming win the match against Team WE.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Team WE and JD Gaming each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 1.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders price a 95.5% implied probability of no change to the federal funds rate at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, reflecting the Fed's April 28-29 decision to hold steady at 3.50%-3.75%—its third consecutive pause—amid March CPI accelerating to 3.3% year-over-year, the highest in two years, and resilient nonfarm payrolls adding 178,000 jobs despite a slight unemployment uptick to 4.6%. Officials' recent speeches underscore patience with sticky inflation above the 2% target and solid labor market conditions, aligning with CME FedWatch Tool odds near 98%. This strong consensus could face challenges from softer-than-expected April CPI data due May 12 or weakening May jobs, potentially boosting 25 basis point cut probabilities.

eventMetadata.context_description: With the Eastern Conference first-round series tied 3-3, Game 7 tips off Saturday at TD Garden where the No. 2 Celtics hold home-court advantage against the No. 7 76ers, boasting a 27-10 all-time record in elimination games. Philadelphia seized momentum by holding Boston under 100 points in back-to-back wins, including Thursday's 106-93 Game 6 victory behind Tyrese Maxey's 30 points and Joel Embiid's 19 despite his post-appendectomy recovery—he's listed probable on the injury report. Jayson Tatum is cleared after exiting Game 6 early with left calf tightness, giving the Celtics their full roster amid this heated rivalry. Boston's recent offensive struggles contrast their dominant Game 4 (128-96), underscoring defensive battles and star availability as key to advancement.

eventMetadata.context_description: Bayern Munich's commanding Bundesliga position as champions with 82 points from 31 matches, including a league-high 113 goals scored, drives their 76.5% implied probability as heavy home favorites at Allianz Arena against relegation-haunted Heidenheim, who sit 18th on 22 points with a joint-worst defense conceding 66 goals. Recent midweek Champions League semi-final first-leg loss 4-5 to PSG prompts heavy rotation under Vincent Kompany—resting stars like Harry Kane and Manuel Neuer amid injuries to Serge Gnabry and Raphael Guerreiro—yet squad depth and a 5-1 head-to-head record, including 4-0 earlier this season, sustain trader confidence. Heidenheim's morale-boosting 2-0 win over St. Pauli last weekend aids survival hopes but poor away form (no wins in 10) limits upset potential to 9.5%, with draw at 13.5% reflecting competitive stakes.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes teammates Kimi Antonelli and George Russell dominate the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship Polymarket, reflecting their stranglehold on early-race podiums with Antonelli leading standings at 72 points to Russell's 63 after three Grands Prix—wins for Antonelli in China and Japan, Russell in Australia. Trader consensus prices Russell slightly ahead at 31.5% implied probability over Antonelli's 30.8%, betting on the veteran's consistency in a 24-race grind amid the rookie's stunning debut, including back-to-back poles. McLaren's heavy Miami upgrades propelled Lando Norris to sprint pole yesterday, ending Mercedes' qualifying streak and hinting at narrowing gaps, while Red Bull's struggles keep Max Verstappen sidelined at 4%. Intra-team tension and rival convergence keep the title fight fiercely competitive.

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $150 in May?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "Low" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily low price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader sentiment on Polymarket for WTI crude oil price ranges in May 2026 reflects elevated geopolitical risk premiums from the US-Iran conflict, which has curtailed Strait of Hormuz flows and prompted 6.7 million b/d of Middle East production shut-ins per EIA's latest Short-Term Energy Outlook. Spot WTI settled at $102.50/bbl on May 1, down 2.5% amid hopes for resumed US-Iran diplomacy after Iran's foreign minister signaled flexibility, partially offsetting a 6.2 million bbl US crude inventory draw for the week ended April 24. OPEC+ eight members approved a modest 206,000 b/d output increase for May upon Strait reopening. Key catalysts include tomorrow's EIA inventories, May 3 JMMC meeting, and IEA's monthly report, with Brent-WTI spreads at $12/bbl signaling regional supply strains.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: LoL: Invictus Gaming vs Anyone's Legend (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 2 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Invictus Gaming" if Invictus Gaming win the match against Anyone's Legend.

This market will resolve to "Anyone's Legend" if Anyone's Legend win the match against Invictus Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 3: Both Teams Slay Baron Nashor?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay the Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. Baron Nashor is a powerful neutral objective in League of Legends that first spawns at 20:00 game time and respawns 6 minutes after each death, granting the slaying team the Hand of Baron buff.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend each slay Baron Nashor at least once during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay Baron Nashor during Game 3.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 3 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain Baron Nashor prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 3 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

markets.question: Game 3: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 3. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Invictus Gaming and Anyone's Legend each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 3. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 3. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 3 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain at least one elemental dragon prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 3 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Anyone's Legend holds a narrow edge in trader consensus for this LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Ascend BO3 rematch against Invictus Gaming, fueled by their recent 2-0 sweep of IG on April 28 and yesterday's dominant 2-0 upset over second-place Top Esports, extending a four-series win streak to solidify fourth in standings with a +3 game differential. IG sits sixth at 3-5 overall but showed resilience in a 2-1 reverse sweep of Weibo Gaming on May 1, leveraging their stable roster including Rookie and new head coach Helper—formerly of AL—for potential stylistic edges. Head-to-head history favors AL (12-5 maps), though double round-robin format and top-four playoff spots heighten stakes amid Patch 26.7 meta shifts.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance commands trader consensus at 21.6% implied probability as the early Republican frontrunner, bolstered by his top finishes in recent GOP primary straw polls like CPAC in late March and New Hampshire in February, alongside presumed incumbency advantages and likely Trump endorsement ahead of 2026 midterms. California Governor Gavin Newsom trails closely at 17.3%, reflecting his national profile via book tours and post-midterm positioning signals in February polls favoring him among Democrats. Senator Marco Rubio holds third at 10.7% amid gains in informal surveys. The fragmented field across both parties keeps the race tight two years out, with 2026 midterm outcomes, administration performance, fresh polling shifts like Echelon Insights' April updates, and potential scandals poised to create separation in this open primary cycle.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Post-municipal elections in late March 2026, trader consensus on Polymarket reflects recent polls showing Jordan Bardella leading first-round voting intentions at 34-42% amid Rassemblement National gains and public desire for change, while Édouard Philippe surges to 18-36% buoyed by his Le Havre mayoral reelection and appeal as the strongest center-right runoff contender, defeating Bardella 51-52% to 48% in Elabe and Odoxa surveys. This keeps the race tight in a fragmented field, with Jean-Luc Mélenchon stuck at 12-15% due to left divisions and Les Républicains' April selection of Bruno Retailleau failing to consolidate conservatives. Separation could arise from party primaries, unified anti-far-right candidacies, economic shifts, or scandals before the April 2027 vote.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 30 - May 2, 2026?
description:

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing reciprocal blockades by Iran and the United States have kept Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic at about 5% of pre-February 2026 crisis levels, with only 6-14 vessels—mostly Iran-linked—transiting daily versus the normal 125-140, per recent Kpler and Reuters tracking. Despite an April 8 ceasefire, Iran reimposed restrictions after ship attacks and failed negotiations, while US naval enforcement redirects Iran-bound tankers, stranding over 2,000 vessels in the Persian Gulf. Fresh US warnings on May 2 against sanctions for paying Iranian tolls underscore persistent risks, alongside elevated insurance premiums and routing uncertainty. Traders' 94.5% consensus against normalization by May 15 reflects this stalemate, though a diplomatic breakthrough or de-escalation could shift odds.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's declaration yesterday that hostilities with Iran are "terminated," coupled with ongoing US naval seizures of Iranian oil cargoes near the Strait of Hormuz—which he likened to "piracy"—has kept the April 12-imposed blockade firmly in place despite diplomatic overtures. Iran's recent proposal to reopen the strait in exchange for ending the US blockade and war was dismissed, as Trump signals a prolonged standoff now exceeding 20 days to pressure Tehran's oil-dependent economy amid rising global energy prices. Traders weigh this against de-escalation hints and upcoming Trump-Xi talks flagged by China's UN envoy as prioritizing Hormuz access, with consensus tilting toward a potential lifting announcement by late May if economic strains or backchannel negotiations yield concessions, though no immediate resolution appears likely before mid-month deadlines.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

In the past 30 days, a reported execution spree launched April 1 quelled immediate uprising fears, while no verified mass defections, territorial losses, or opposition breakthroughs have materialized despite economic pressures from Strait of Hormuz disruptions and leadership decapitation strikes killing figures like Ayatollah Khamenei. title: Elon Musk # tweets May 1 - May 8, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 1 12:00 PM ET to May 8, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.
